newsitem.title: USA: Nevada $81 mln GOs repriced, top yield unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Nevada $81 mln GOs repriced, top yield unchanged.

text.p: Goldman, Sachs & Co. said Tuesday it repriced Nevada's $81.2 million general obligation bond deal, adjusting yields in several maturities but leaving the top yield in 2011 unchanged at 5.05 percent.
VERBAL AWARD AT THE FOLLOWING REPRICING:

BONDS, OR PORTIONS THEREOF, MATURING ON AND AFTER MAY 15, 2008 SHALL BE SUBJECT TO REDEMPTION PRIOR TO THEIR RESPECTIVE MATURITIES, AT THE OPTION OF THE STATE, ON AND AFTER MAY 15, 2007 BUT ONLY IN THE EVENT THE BOARD DETERMINES A CHANGE OF USE HAS OCCURRED AS A RESULT OF WHICH EXERCISE OF THIS REDEMPTION WILL IN PART SATISFY THE STATE'S OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 44 HEREOF IN WHOLE OR IN PART AT ANY TIME FROM ANY MATURITIES SELECTED BY THE STATE AND BY LOT WITHIN A MATURITY (GIVING PROPORTIONATE WEIGHT TO BONDS IN DENOMINATIONS LARGER THAN $5000), AT A PRICE EQUAL TO THE ISSUE PRICE OF EACH BOND, OR PORTION THEREOF, SO REDEEMED, ACCRUED INTEREST TO THE REDEMPTION DATE, AND A PREMIUM COMPUTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE FOLLOWING SCHEDULE:
IN THE CASE OF BONDS OF A DENOMINATION LARGER

THAN $5000, A PORTION OF SUCH BONDS ($5000 OR ANY INTEGRAL MULTIPLE THEROF) MAY BE REDEEMED, IN WHICH CASE THE REGISTRAR SHALL, WITHOUT CHARGE TO THE OWNER OF SUCH BOND, AUTHENTICATE AND ISSUE A REPLACEMENT BOND OR BONDS FOR THE UNREDEEMED PORTION THEREOF.
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
The award is expected Friday, July 11, 1997.
This issue is book entry through DTC.
